wiki.title: Steve Hobbs (Washington politician)
wiki.extract: Steven Ryuma Hobbs (born February 12, 1970) is an American military officer and politician serving as the 16th secretary of state of Washington since 2021. A member of the Democratic Party, he previously served as a member of the Washington State Senate, representing the 44th district from 2007 to 2021. In 2021, Governor Jay Inslee named Hobbs to succeed the departing Kim Wyman as Secretary of State of Washington; he is the first Democrat in the state to serve in the position since Victor Aloysius Meyers left the office in 1965.
